name: sensitive-paths
description: Blocks Claude from reading or writing secret-bearing files (.env, SSH keys, cloud credentials, and your own globs) through the file tools and, best effort, Bash

protected.title: Extra protected globs
protected.description: Globs to protect on top of the built-in list, e.g. ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml or **/secrets/**. ~/ is your home; a glob not starting with / or ~/ matches at any depth.

allowed.title: Allowed globs
allowed.description: Globs that are never blocked, even when a protected glob matches, e.g. **/fixtures/**/*.pem. Added to the built-in exceptions (.env.example, .env.sample, .env.template, *.pub).

check_bash.title: Check Bash commands
check_bash.description: Also block Bash commands whose words name a protected path (cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa, source .env). Best effort: a command can always build a path the check cannot see.

read_mode.title: On a read
read_mode.description: What happens when Read, Glob or Grep targets a protected path: deny refuses it, ask puts it to your permission prompt, off allows it.

write_mode.title: On a write
write_mode.description: What happens when Edit, Write or NotebookEdit targets a protected path: deny refuses it, ask puts it to your permission prompt, off allows it. Bash uses the stricter of the two modes.
